constraints.text: StartSession clears only identity?'s own plan-marker entry (planSet'(identity) = zfalse), not the whole planSet function.
StartSession's clear of its own key does not clear a concurrent sibling identity's already-set plan (the direct om9 fix).
StartSubagent registers a fresh, unset plan entry for a dispatched subagent's own agent_id, keyed separately from its leader's own hint.
SubagentStart with no agent_id present on the payload is a no-op (no spurious plan-entry registration).
PreToolHookAllow/PreToolHookDeny: the gate hard-denies Edit/Write when the (mocked, identity-blind) plan marker is unset, and allows when set.
PreToolUse gate fails closed (denies) when reading the plan marker raises, rather than silently allowing.

uncovered.text: PreToolHookAllow's core om9-fix guard -- identity? IN dom planSet AND planSet(identity?) = ztrue -- is checked against THAT SPECIFIC identity, not any identity's plan marker present in the same worktree. The one existing gate test helper (_gate_mocks in tests/test_hook.py:1270) mocks has_plan_marker with a blanket `return_value=plan` regardless of the identity argument it is called with, so no test currently distinguishes 'my own identity has a plan' from 'some other identity sharing this worktree has a plan, but I do not.'
uncovered.suggestion: Add a test asserting handle_pre_tool_use denies Edit/Write when has_plan_marker(root, OTHER_identity) is True but has_plan_marker(root, THIS session's own identity) is False -- i.e. mock has_plan_marker with a side_effect keyed on the identity argument, not a blanket return_value, and assert the gate resolves and passes its OWN identity (not a sibling's) to the check.
